items: 【Please Charge the Watch to Activate】This smart watch requires initial charging to activate. Use the included charging cable. Download VeryFit app to sync with your smartphone. Compatible with Android 6.0+ and iOS 9.0+ devices. (𝐍𝐨𝐭 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞𝐭𝐬 𝐨𝐫 𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐩𝐮𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐬)

【2 Straps, Zero Weight, All-Day Style】Two quick-release straps for instant style changes. This ladies smart watch features a 1.83" HD display weighing just 38g—so light that teens, women, and men forget it’s there. Enjoy razor-sharp colors with 360*440 resolution. Choose from 100+ watch faces to match your daily style.

【2026 Upgraded All-Day Health Guardian on Your Wrist】This women men smartwatch provides 24/7 monitoring of heart rate, SpO₂ and stress levels. Guided breathing exercises help restore calm. Automatically tracks sleep stages (𝐞𝐱𝐜𝐥𝐮𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐧𝐚𝐩𝐬). Women's cycle tracking and hydration reminders included.

【Your Personal Coach for 110+ Ways to Move】As a versatile fitness tracker watch, it offers 110+ professional sports modes with auto-recognition for running/walking. Tracks calories, steps and distance in real-time. IP68 waterproof for swimming and rain activities. 𝐃𝐨𝐧'𝐭 𝐰𝐞𝐚𝐫 𝐢𝐭 𝐢𝐧 𝐡𝐨𝐭 𝐛𝐚𝐭𝐡𝐬, 𝐬𝐚𝐮𝐧𝐚𝐬 𝐨𝐫 𝐝𝐢𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠.

【Effortless Communication on the Go】Make and receive calls directly through VeryFit app. This reloj inteligente delivers instant notifications from apps like WhatsApp and SMS. Customize sound and vibration settings. Use Do Not Disturb mode when needed.

【Intuitive Alexa Watch】Activate Alexa by pressing power button or tapping the icon. This advanced fitness watch lets you ask questions, set alarms, control music, check weather. Manage Alexa-enabled smart devices through voice commands.

【Powerful Battery Life & Multiple Practical Functions】This reliable smart watch delivers 7-day battery life, extending to 30 days of standby time. Includes wake-up alarm, stopwatch, music & camera remote, brightness adjustment, weather forecast, flashlight, cycle tracking and "find my phone" feature.
